## 做了什么 / What this does

<!-- 一两句话。新插件请写：玩法、座位数、需要的能力。 / One or two sentences. For a new plugin: the game, seat count, capabilities requested. -->

## 清单 / Checklist

- [ ] `npx aiatt-plugin test` 在本地通过 / passes locally
- [ ] 在模拟器或调试房里完整玩过一局 / played a full match in the simulator or a debug room
- [ ] 隐藏信息只出现在对应座位的视图里，`secrets()` 已声明 / hidden information appears only in the matching seat's view and is declared in `secrets()`
- [ ] 没有文件、网络、子进程、`eval`、`Date.now()`、`Math.random()` / no files, network, child processes, `eval`, `Date.now()`, `Math.random()`
- [ ] 玩家可见的文字至少有简体中文 / player-facing text has at least Simplified Chinese
- [ ] 图片、声音等素材是我自己的作品或明确可用，并以 Apache-2.0 发布 / assets are my own or clearly licensed for Apache-2.0
- [ ] 每个源文件第一行有 `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` / every source file starts with the SPDX line
- [ ] 没有密钥、令牌、内部地址、个人邮箱、本机路径；`node tools/scan/scan.mjs . --changed origin/main` 通过 / no keys, tokens, internal addresses, personal e-mail or local paths; the scan passes
- [ ] 我有权提交这些代码，并同意按 Apache-2.0 授权 / I may submit this code and license it under Apache-2.0
